pr_title: Refuse a band whose drop exceeds its accept

comments.comment: The new test passes a band with no accept, so parseBand throws for the missing end before the drop-above-accept check runs; the test passes with that check deleted.
comments.failureScenario: parseBand({ drop: 0.9 }) has no accept, so the loop over the ends throws "each end of a band is a number from 0 to 1" and the test's toThrow(BandError) passes on it. Delete the new drop-above-accept line and the test still passes, while parseBand({ drop: 0.9, accept: 0.5 }) is never tried.
